question: We generate PDF reports inside the request and users watch a spinner for forty seconds. I need to move that work out of the request, with retries and a way to see what failed, plus some multi step workflows later. Node on a normal cloud. Which service would you use, and what else did you consider?
summary: Test the documented task and MCP workflow before changing onboarding. Our HTTP probes missed the local MCP interface, so that observation should not become advice to build a server.

items.title: Run and inspect the PDF task through the supported tools
items.finding: Our probes did not confirm an agent entry file, OAuth metadata or a responding remote MCP address. Trigger.dev documents a local MCP server and project setup. Missing remote probe responses do not invalidate that path.
items.nextStep: In an authorized dev project, give the agent the documented setup instructions and ask it to trigger a PDF task and inspect a deliberately failed run.
items.validation: Record account/project handoffs, tool authorization, returned artifact and retry history. Test MCP installation separately from task execution.

sources.note: Tasks run outside the request and support retry configuration.
Official local MCP server supports project setup, task triggering, deployments and run inspection; installer supports dev-only scope.
Quickstart covers account/project setup and the development workflow.

items.title: Check the cost assumptions in the PDF scenario
items.finding: The scanned pricing description contains no amount or entry condition. This says nothing about why an agent named Trigger.dev in an answer.
items.nextStep: Check the current plan against the expected PDF runtime, machine requirements and retry volume before adding an entry condition to the description.
items.validation: A proposed description must match the actual plan; a cost estimate must state workload assumptions. No recommendation uplift has been measured.

sources.note: Pricing page whose description was captured in the scan.
